message.darkspawn.griffin_no_room: There is not enough headroom to mount here.
message.darkspawn.griffin_mounted: Griffin: movement keys to steer, jump to rise, Descend / Land key to lower. Sneak dismounts.
message.darkspawn.mount_ability_hint: Use Mount: Ability for its attack (rhino: move forward).
message.darkspawn.mount_feed_wait: Let your mount finish eating. Try again in a moment.
message.darkspawn.mount_full_health: Your mount is already at full health.
message.darkspawn.mount_trusting_other: This mount is building trust with another player. Try again later.
message.darkspawn.mount_trust: Mount trust: %s/%s. Feed again after two seconds.
message.darkspawn.mount_tamed: This mount is now yours! Empty-hand right-click to ride. No saddle needed.
message.darkspawn.mount_other_owner: This mount belongs to another player.
message.darkspawn.mount_needs_taming: Build trust with three feedings of %s before riding.
message.darkspawn.mount_saved: Companion stored. Use the capsule on a safe surface to release.
message.darkspawn.mount_action_failed: Use an empty capsule on your free companion, or a veterinary kit on your injured companion.
message.darkspawn.mount_release_failed: Cannot release here. Check ownership, room, safe footing (deep water for seahorses), and a veterinary kit for recovery.
message.darkspawn.mount_unavailable: This companion is growing, ready to breed, or awaiting a transfer response.
message.darkspawn.mount_care_failed: Request unavailable. Check health, food, cooldown, and nearby players.
message.darkspawn.mount_transfer_offer: %s offers you %s, including its cargo. Sneak-right-click it empty-handed and accept within 60 seconds.
mount.darkspawn.follow_hint: Follow the owner within 32 blocks in this dimension. No teleporting or chunk loading.
mount.darkspawn.stay_hint: Stop following and cancel breeding readiness. Flyers settle to the ground.
mount.darkspawn.breed_hint: Two healthy adult companions of the same species and owner, both on Stay. Uses one preferred food from your inventory. Five-minute parent cooldown.
mount.darkspawn.next_player_hint: Cycle through living players within eight blocks of the companion.
mount.darkspawn.offer_hint: Offer this companion and its cargo to the selected player. Both players must remain nearby to accept.
mount.darkspawn.accept_hint: Accept ownership, including cargo. The previous owner loses access immediately.
tooltip.darkspawn.companion_capsule.use: Use on your free companion to store it with its cargo.
tooltip.darkspawn.companion_capsule.deta: Use on safe ground to release; seahorses need deep water.
tooltip.darkspawn.veterinary_kit.use: Use on your injured companion to fully heal it.
tooltip.darkspawn.veterinary_kit.detail: Carry to redeem recovery tokens. Use in air to reclaim a lost recovery token.
